svg.aria-label: System Context Diagram — DBCAS (generated from Compose + code)
svg.title: System Context Diagram — DBCAS (generated from Compose + code)
svg.desc: 15 nodes, 23 directed labelled flows; arrow IDs are decoded in the flow legend below; every flow carries evidence
svg.text: System Context Diagram — DBCAS (generated from Compose + code)
Actors = green · services = blue · QA-only = amber · external systems = purple/pink · arrows show the direction of data/control flow (Fxx = legend row)

g.title: docker-compose.local.yml service app, ports 18000:8000, alias backend
docker-compose.local.yml service db, LOCAL_DATABASE_URL, networks database:internal
docker-compose.local.yml service init, command python -m app.seed_demo
learner -> frontend | HTTPS: SPA, static assets, /assessments | frontend/Dockerfile; compose ports 18080:8080
admin -> frontend | HTTPS: admin SPA (5 mục) | Layout.jsx ADMIN_LINKS
frontend -> app | HTTP /api/v1/* (nginx proxy → backend:8000) | compose networks web alias backend; frontend nginx config
app -> frontend | JSON responses (OpenAPI 82 paths / 93 ops) | app.openapi(); routers/*.py
app -> db | SQL read/write (SQLAlchemy, internal network `database`) | LOCAL_DATABASE_URL; app/db.py
db -> app | query results / 41 tables | db/schema.sql introspection
init -> db | schema.sql + 19 migrations + seed_demo (0 đề) | compose init command; app/seed_demo.py exam_count=0
executor_image -> sandbox | build image dbcas-sql-ephemeral:local | compose executor-image build; sandbox/Dockerfile.ephemeral
app -> sandbox | docker create/start/exec/rm via docker.sock | ephemeral_sandbox.py docker_cli(); compose volume /var/run/docker.sock
sandbox -> app | read-only SQL result rows | app/sandbox_job.py; services/sandbox_runner.py
app -> prompt_builder | build_prompt(data, model_path, timeout) | services/evaluation_pipeline.py evaluate()
prompt_builder -> app | prompt text + prompt_hash + builder_fallback | services/prompt_builder.py PromptResult
app -> llm | HTTPS chat/completions: evaluation + practice_questions | services/llm/provider.py; LLM_BASE_URL
llm -> app | structured JSON (Evaluation / QuestionBatch) | services/evaluation_pipeline.py; practice_generation.py
app -> mailpit | SMTP :1025 password-reset email | services/mail.py; SMTP_HOST=mailpit SMTP_PORT=1025
mailpit -> learner | reset link qua mailbox UI :18025 | frontend VITE_LOCAL_MAILBOX_URL; e2e/local-smoke.spec.js
app -> google | OAuth 302 authorize redirect | routers/oauth.py; config google_redirect_uri
google -> app | OAuth callback code → token | routers/oauth.py; /auth/callback
app -> github | OAuth 302 authorize redirect | routers/oauth.py; config github_redirect_uri
github -> app | OAuth callback code → token | routers/oauth.py; /auth/callback
qa_ai -> app | deterministic fake AI JSON (QA only) | docker-compose.qa.yml LLM_BASE_URL=http://qa-ai:8080/v1
app -> meter | outbound request counted (opt-in QA) | real_provider_qa.py install_meter() wraps httpx.HTTPTransport.handle_request
meter -> llm | forwarded metered HTTPS request | real_provider_qa.py counted(); ledger.json
